summary: M7.1 targeted corrective patch independently verified via curl+psql. Backend scenarios 1 (RACE), 2 (REACQUISITION), 3 (RELEASED-ROW) all pass with 36/36 checks (see /app/tests/m71_independent.py). Late CLICK Complete correctly (a) blocks expired-reservation direct commits, returns payment_status=reconciliation_required, order_status=payment_review, order_payment_state=review, complete step error=-7 (existing CLICK UPDATE_FAILURE code, no invented code); (b) atomically reacquires when stock is available with an auditable replacement reservation row whose reacquired_from points to the original expired/released row; (c) is idempotent on repeated late Completes (no duplicate decrement, no new rows, cart preserved when unpaid); (d) cart cleared only on truly-paid. Frontend regressions (shop PLP, cart, wishlist guest->login redirect, login, orders redirect) all render cleanly with zero non-401/429 console errors. i18n keys pay.review / payment_review / mockPay.reviewTitle present 4 times each in translations.js (id/en/uz/ru). Main-agent pytest suite tests/test_checkout_m71.py — when I run it after my testing it 3-fails due to (a) global order-rate-limit 30/15min per IP consumed by my curl runs, (b) minor stock exhaustion; not a code bug, just per-IP quota + shared PG state. Verified independently via direct HTTP+psql anyway. UI end-to-end Simulate SUCCESS (scenario 4) blocked by same rate-limit (429 on /checkout/orders) — could not complete UI checkout during this window; UI code path is unchanged from iteration_11 (which passed).
critical_code_review_comments: ORDER_RATE_LIMIT=30 per 15min per client IP in routers/checkout.py can flake integration test suites that run curl repeatedly from same IP (observed 429s after ~30 orders). Consider bumping in TEST mode or exempting loopback for CI.
M7.1 reconciliation branch correctly reuses CLICK error code -7 (UPDATE_FAILURE) rather than inventing a new code — good adherence to spec.

rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration was verification of an already-shipped fix. The fix behaves exactly as specified: late Complete against an expired/released reservation reaches reconcile_paid_effects which (with row lock on product_variants) tries to reacquire; if unavailable, transitions payment.status='reconciliation_required' and order.status='payment_review' with payment_state='review' and returns CLICK error -7; if available, creates a fresh committed reservation with reacquired_from set to the original row and clears the source cart. Repeated calls short-circuit on already-terminal state (idempotent).
